guard: runtimes reports a provider that cannot load as a partial read, ps and models refuse an unresolvable mesh under its own code before any request, a home reached through a symlink is not a project, ps refuses a malformed --on as a usage envelope, and no report line ends in padding
command: pnpm --filter cotal-ai... build && pnpm exec tsx implementations/cli/smoke/read-envelopes.smoke.ts
why: The suite drives the built binary, so each mutation rebuilds it and the restore rebuilds it back. Two mutations are in @cotal-ai/workspace, which the binary's build closure includes.

mutations.name: a provider that cannot load leaves the read complete
mutations.expectRed: a provider that cannot load makes runtimes --json partial, exit 4
mutations.cell: a provider that cannot load makes runtimes --json partial, exit 4

mutations.name: a provider that cannot load is dropped from the list
mutations.find: items.push({ name, state: "installed", package: pkg, reachable: null, error: (e as Error).message });
mutations.expectRed: a provider that cannot load makes runtimes --json partial, exit 4
mutations.cell: a provider that cannot load makes runtimes --json partial, exit 4

mutations.name: no mesh is reported as an unavailable broker
mutations.expectRed: ps --json with no mesh is one TARGET_NOT_FOUND envelope, exit 2
mutations.cell: ps --json with no mesh is one TARGET_NOT_FOUND envelope, exit 2

mutations.name: the home check compares the spelling, not the canonical path
mutations.expectRed: ps --json from a home reached through a symlink is TARGET_NOT_FOUND, not a mesh in that home
mutations.cell: ps --json from a home reached through a symlink is TARGET_NOT_FOUND, not a mesh in that home

mutations.name: ps exits on a connect refusal instead of throwing it
mutations.find: const t = await resolveControlTarget(v, "control-caller-privileged", on, { onRefusal: "throw" });
mutations.expectRed: ps --json with no mesh is one TARGET_NOT_FOUND envelope, exit 2
mutations.cell: ps --json with no mesh is one TARGET_NOT_FOUND envelope, exit 2

mutations.name: ps validates --on by exiting
mutations.expectRed: ps an empty --on is one USAGE_INVALID envelope, exit 1, before any mesh is resolved
mutations.cell: ps an empty --on is one USAGE_INVALID envelope, exit 1, before any mesh is resolved

mutations.name: a table line keeps the padding before an empty last cell
mutations.expectRed: no report line ends in padding
mutations.cell: no report line ends in padding

mutations.name: a runtime that is not installed hides its package
mutations.find: package: { text: row.package ?? "included with Cotal", tone: "hint" }
mutations.replace: package: { text: row.state === "not-installed" ? "" : row.package ?? "included with Cotal", tone: "hint" }
mutations.expectRed: runtimes draws a colored table with its state words
mutations.cell: runtimes draws a colored table with its state words
